sloka: प्रवेक्ष्ये दण्डकारण्यमहमप्यविलम्बयन् ।आभ्यां तु सहितो राजन् वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च ॥ २.१०७.१६॥
transliteration: pravekṣye daṇḍakāraṇyamahamapyavilambayan ।ābhyāṁ tu sahito rājan vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca ॥ 2.107.16॥

translations.english: O king (Bharata) I shall also enter the Dandaka forest without delay in the company of only these two -- the princess from Videha (Sita) and Lakshmana.
